axis1_stambaugh_3source_retest.description: Stambaugh 2015 RFS post-publication anomaly attenuation framework — 3 source 정량

framework.primary_paper: Stambaugh-Yu-Yuan 2015 RFS Mispricing Factors. Avg out-of-sample decay 56% across 11 anomalies (range 10%~100%)
framework.secondary: McLean-Pontiff 2016 JF / Chordia-Subrahmanyam-Tong 2014 JFE / Harvey-Liu-Zhu 2016 RFS multiple testing
framework.method: Empirical pre/post split per source publication date + Welch t (Lo 2002 SR variance) + Politis-Romano 1994 stationary bootstrap (B=1000, block_mean=6) + half-life OLS (log SR_t = log SR_0 - λ·t) + Bayesian normal-normal conjugate posterior

AR_threshold_K5_W252.split_note: AR threshold framework (Kritzman-Page-Turkington 2011 FAJ) implemented 2018+; pre 2005-02~2017-12 (n=155) vs post 2018-01~2026-03 (n=99)
AR_threshold_K5_W252.interpretation: Decay 36.9% positive but Welch p=0.13 미유의 + bootstrap CI [-1.72, 0.24] zero 포함. Half-life 189m (15.8년) — sample period 기준 매우 slow decay. Sample 작아 (n_pre=155, n_post=99) noise 큼

TSMOM_12m.split_note: Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012 JFE published 2012-12 BUT TSMOM data series starts 2015-01 (cycle 2 inheritance). Empirical pre/post-publication split impossible. TSMOM_12m.interpretation: Mid-sample proxy decay 25.5% — Welch p=0.66 미유의 + bootstrap CI 0 포함. Half-life 64m (5.4년) — 3 source 중 가장 fast decay (TSMOM published 14년 효과 정합). 정식 split impossible — caveat retain

KR10y_carry.split_note: Korea BoK 통화정책 normalization onset 2017+ (Cieslak-Povala 2015 RFS Treasury bond expected returns framework); pre 2005-02~2016-12 (n=143) vs post 2017-01~2026-03 (n=111)
KR10y_carry.interpretation: Decay 77.5% — 3 source 중 가장 심각. Welch p=0.11 미유의 (sample size 한계) + bootstrap CI [-1.58, 0.11] zero 거의 접촉. SR_post 0.20 → 사실상 dead source. 6/1 발효 시 15% allocation 적용 critical risk

bayesian_posterior.framework: Normal-Normal conjugate update on decay rate mean parameter
bayesian_posterior.prior_rationale: Stambaugh literature avg 0.56 + Cieslak prior wide uncertainty 0.20. Conservative starting prior μ=0.30 (낮은쪽) σ=0.20 (wide)
bayesian_posterior.interpretation: Posterior decay rate ~ N(0.44, 0.08^2). Prior shift 0.30 → 0.44 (+47% upward). 95% CI [0.28, 0.60] — Stambaugh 0.56 within CI. KR10y 0.78 outside → outlier-driven likelihood

axis2_joint_decay_correlation.description: 3-source joint decay correlation diagnostic + multivariate copula tail dependence

innovation_correlation_matrix.definition: First difference of rolling 36m SR per source
innovation_correlation_matrix.interpretation: 3-source decay innovations 거의 무상관 (|cor| < 0.15). 즉 source 간 decay 동조성 부재. Hybrid 70/15/15는 decay risk 차원 effective diversification

joint_decay_lower_quantile_probability.interpretation: Joint decay (3 source 모두 lower 25% 동시) 발생 0건 / 99 — Independence baseline 0.0156 미달. 즉 decay 발생 시점이 source 간 systematic 동시발생 X. Hybrid level diversification benefit 있음

parametric_copula_fit.method: Student-t copula (df-free MLE) + Clayton copula MLE compare
parametric_copula_fit.interpretation: df=20.2 → Gaussian limit 가까움. TDC ≈ 0 모든 pair — extreme tail 동조성 거의 없음. Clayton lower tail 모형도 theta 0.08 nearly independent. 사이클 7 CRISIS AR-TSMOM cor 0.6438은 n=8 sub-sample noise 가능성 높음 (cycle 8 parametric copula 결과로 확정 evidence)

decay_regime_hybrid_impact.interpretation: Joint decay regime 발생 0건 — Hybrid empirical impact 측정 impossible. 즉 cycle 8 framework 차원에서 joint decay shock 없었음. Forward simulation은 axis 3 Bayesian
